When I was in kindergarten (about 5 years old), we had something like half an hour of lunch time. My lunch was a pack of plain biscuits and an apple. I was a terribly slow eater. When lunch time was up, I hadn't finished eating yet, so my teacher came to me and stuffed the remaining 3 biscuits into my mouth, grabbed my head and made me chew them, than stuff the remaining piece of apple into my mouth. This activated my gag reflex, and I puked all over the table. I've always had emetophobia, so vomiting always scared me and made me cry. The kid sitting across from me, at the same table, was an extremely nonchalant kid. He never cried. He never complained. He just sat there, with his elbow on the table, supporting his head with his arm. He didn't seem bothered that I was barfing all over the table. The puke puddle eventually got to his elbow and started to moisten the fabric of his shirt. He didn't say anything. He didn't even move. He just let a huge wave of his own vomit cascade over my gastric-juice-lunch-puddle.

So that's the story about how my teacher made 2 kids vomit by only laying hands on one. The poor cleaning lady, she always had to clean after us and would often wipe our asses clean when we went to the bathroom and forgot that we didn't know how to wipe.
